components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; max-width: 720px; margin: 1rem auto; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid oklch(90.2% 0.063 306.7); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #261a2a, 10px 10px 0 #dab2ff; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-logo { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 1rem; background: oklch(0.182 0.046 286.89); color: oklch(90.2% 0.063 306.7); font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: oklch(90.2% 0.063 306.7); } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 1rem; text-decoration: none; color: #261a2a; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; background: oklch(0.182 0.046 286.89); transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item--active { background: oklch(90.2% 0.063 306.7); color: #261a2a; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.8325 0.107 306.71); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A portfolio visual system that feels like a well-used workbench: warm craft, curious experiments, and tools laid out with intention. Surfaces are plum-dark and lavender-bright in deliberate contrast; structure comes from grids, borders, and stacked offset shadows rather than soft SaaS blur.
keyCharacteristics: Deep plum night backgrounds with lavender mist type and borders
Hard offset shadows (5px/10px stack) on navigation and key chrome
Poppins-forward hierarchy with Fira Code for technical labels
Alternating background/secondary bands for list-like proof sections
Technology brand colors reserved for stack icons and inline tech emphasis only

rules.name: The Two-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Signature offset depth uses exactly two hard layers (plum then lilac). Do not add a third drop shadow or soften into diffuse blur on nav-level chrome.

rules.name: The Tech Color Rule
rules.body: Per-technology hues appear only on devicons and inline tech emphasis, never as page-wide accents or gradient fills.

rules.name: The Bold Step Rule
rules.body: Every section title jumps at least one clear step above body. Flat type scales are forbidden.

rules.name: The Hard Edge Rule
rules.body: Shadows have zero or minimal blur. If a shadow looks like a 2014 soft drop, remove the blur and use offset stacks or tonal bands instead.

dos: Do use OKLCH tokens from packages/ui as the single source of truth.
Do stack exactly two offset shadows on signature chrome.
Do alternate background/secondary bands for long proof lists.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for Framer Motion and CSS transitions.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS portfolio patterns: hero metrics, identical icon-card grids, gradient text, or decorative glass cards.
Don't adopt dark-mode neon hacker aesthetics or meaningless purple gradient washes.
Don't ship obvious AI slop: glassmorphism as default, side-stripe accent borders, modal-first interactions.
Don't soften nav shadows into diffuse blur or add a third shadow layer.
Don't use background-clip text gradient fills for emphasis.
